ShopTenant.title: ShopTenant
ShopTenant.description: Multi-tenant restaurant configuration document containing public storefront settings, menu catalog, spin-wheel offers, and SaaS subscription control.

shopId.description: Unique tenant shop slug matching the document ID.

shopConfig.description: Public restaurant storefront branding, WhatsApp order number, packaging/GST charge config, serviceable radius, and shop GPS coordinates (shopLat, shopLng, maxDeliveryKm).

menuItems.description: Bounded list (max 60) of menu dishes with pricing, descriptions, badges, image URLs, and inStock boolean availability flag.

spinRewards.description: Bounded list (max 10) of Spin & Win wheel slices with labels, colors, and probability weights.

developerControl.description: SaaS developer subscription control: serviceActive boolean, subscriptionExpiry (YYYY-MM-DD), developerBrandName, and developerWhatsapp.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the shop document was initially provisioned.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Role-based access control document granting developer or shop_owner privileges to a verified Firebase Auth UID.

role.description: Access tier assigned to this user.

shopId.description: Assigned tenant shop slug for shop_owner accounts (or '*' for developer).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the role document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest role update.

CloudOrder.title: CloudOrder
CloudOrder.description: Permanent tamper-proof customer order record captured before WhatsApp dispatch so deleted WhatsApp messages never cause lost orders.

docId.description: Firestore document ID for this order.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp when the order was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the order status was last updated.

distanceKm.description: Road-estimated distance in km (-1 when GPS not shared).

items.description: Bounded list (1..40) of ordered dish line items.

/shops/{shopId}.description: Public storefront configuration and developer SaaS subscription state for each restaurant tenant.

/shops/{shopId}/orders/{orderDocId}.description: Permanent append-only customer order log; public validated create, admin/owner-only read and status updates, zero deletes.

/admins/{userId}.description: RBAC registry mapping authenticated user UIDs to developer or shop_owner permissions.
